title: Concept: Jetty default error page disclosed
description: The default container page names the container and often its version, and it appears exactly when the application failed to handle the request. That combination tells the caller which container build they are dealing with at the moment the application is weakest.
applicability: Responses from a Java servlet deployment that has no custom error page.
risk: The caller fingerprints the container build and confirms that error handling is left at the default, which narrows the exploit choice for that version.
